title: Burst of failed remote logons followed by a success
description: 43 failed RemoteInteractive logons against JMP-RDP-01 from a single internet address over 36 minutes, spread across nine accounts, then one success. The successful account is svc_helpdesk.

title: RDP reachable from the public internet
description: The perimeter firewall policy Remote-Access-Legacy permits inbound 3389 from any source address to the jump host. The rule has been in place since March 2021.

title: Inbound scanning denied at perimeter
description: Routine internet background scanning from 198.51.100.140. Every attempt denied by the default-deny inbound policy. No action required.

title: Remote process creation on a file server
description: wmic.exe on JMP-RDP-01 created a process on FS-ACAD-02 using the svc_helpdesk account. An unsigned service binary appeared on the file server thirty seconds later.

title: Large archive written to a hidden share
description: A 2.1 GB zip archive of the AcademicRecords share was written to \\FS-ACAD-02\temp$ by svc_helpdesk. Nothing schedules this.

title: Sustained outbound transfer from a file server
description: FS-ACAD-02 uploaded 2.1 GB over HTTPS to 198.51.100.23 across 27 minutes - the same address that brute-forced the jump host. This matches the size of the staged archive exactly.
